items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Sammy Davis, I was featured with Sammy, you know, I had to accompany him, really.

ctx.x: That's right. I worked with Sammy Davis, I was featured with Sammy, you know, I had to accompany him, really. You know, just guitar and Sammy. These things I just don't understand what happens. You know. Maybe this will set the record straight. You know. I hope so, because this is very disturbing.
Another point, jazz scholars will go to the Smithsonian and find out about you but I hope something gets published, too,
